problems.problem: The formula incorrectly concatenates the speeds instead of taking their difference.
problems.verifierReason: Original lacks operator; |S1−S2| is correct for same-direction relative speed.

problems.quote: Iron ore (hematite and magnetite) reserves exceed 25 billion tonnes
problems.problem: India's iron ore reserves are much lower; the figure 25 billion tonnes refers to total resources (approx. 22.5 billion tonnes), not reserves.
problems.correction: Iron ore (hematite and magnetite) resources are about 22.5 billion tonnes
problems.verifierReason: IBM data: total iron ore resources ~22.5 Bt; reserves ~5.5 Bt. Quote confuses reserves with resources.

problems.problem: The Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal was constituted in 1969, not 2018.
problems.verifierReason: Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal constituted 1969 per ISRWD Act; 2018 is incorrect.

problems.quote: 1,186 blocks were classified as over‑exploited in the 2022 assessment
problems.problem: The 2022 groundwater assessment reported 1,006 over‑exploited blocks; 1,186 was the 2017 figure.
problems.correction: 1,006 blocks were classified as over‑exploited in the 2022 assessment
problems.verifierReason: CGWB 2022 assessment: 1,006 over-exploited units; 1,186 was 2017 figure.

problems.quote: in 2023‑24, MSP procurement covered 43 million tonnes of wheat and 55 million tonnes of rice
problems.problem: Wheat procurement in 2023‑24 was about 26.2 million tonnes; 43 million tonnes was the 2021‑22 figure.
problems.correction: in 2023‑24, MSP procurement covered about 26 million tonnes of wheat and 55 million tonnes of rice
